CHR_022.name: Bix
CHR_022.prompt: BIX, a small round fuzzy bumblebee with an oversized head, golden-yellow and dark-brown stripes, translucent wings with a pale-blue shimmer, huge glossy black eyes with two white highlights each, two antennae with curled tips, tiny dark legs
CHR_022.anim_lock: Bix - round fuzzy bee, golden-yellow and dark-brown stripes, oversized head, big glossy black eyes, curled antennae
CHR_022.movement: Zippy figure-eight flight, wings as a motion blur; droops and sinks when sad.
CHR_022.reference_requirements: Model sheet; flight pose; landing pose.

CHR_023.name: Hive Bees and Guard Bee
CHR_023.prompt: HIVE BEES, a crowd of round fuzzy bumblebees in golden-yellow and dark-brown stripes like Bix but with small variations (one with a flower crown, one plump, one tiny); the GUARD BEE is twice Bix's size, square-jawed, with a dented acorn-cap helmet and stern half-lidded eyes
CHR_023.anim_lock: Hive bees - round fuzzy striped bees; guard bee is twice as big with acorn-cap helmet
CHR_023.movement: Crowd flight cycle; guard bee hovers heavily and blocks with crossed arms.
